steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Compare. Each cost line is matched to its quote, and the total to its lines.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Line with no quote
findings.fix: Get a quote for the line

findings.title: Total does not equal its lines

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] line-housing.md:12  Line with no quote.
       Fix: Get a quote for the line.
[medium] total.csv:19  Total does not equal its lines.
       Fix: Correct the total.
[low] line-allowance.md:26  Assumption not stated.
       Fix: State the assumption.
Not checked: Costs not quoted.
pros: Checks a line with no quote, and a total that does not equal its lines.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-hrc-relocation-cost-estimate skill on the records for this review.
